title: Load WooCommerce block styles only where blocks are used
description: WooCommerce enqueues its block stylesheets site-wide. This keeps them on every WooCommerce page and on any page whose content contains a WooCommerce block, and drops them elsewhere.
breaks: A WooCommerce block inside a template part, a widget area or a page builder is not visible to this check and would lose its styling; such a theme uses the debloater_woo_page_needs_block_styles filter
